as_told.title: Jesse Michels' visit to Skinwalker Ranch

plain: After a visit to Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known as a hot spot for strange happenings, Michels says he had a strange and frightening month. He tells this himself, from his own experience: "these things they instilled fear in me." On a later show he tells it more lightly, saying he went at "my highest ego time in my life" and "didn't have a great month afterwards."
